name: Cerita Lari
description: An Indonesian marathon-tour specialist, founded in 2017, named as an official travel partner by the Tokyo, London, Berlin, Chicago and Cape Town marathons, and describing itself as a travel partner for the New York City Marathon and the TCS Sydney Marathon. Its Explorun brand covers races outside the World Marathon Majors.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Cerita Lari" under Indonesia on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.
Listed as "Cerita Lari" under Indonesia on the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON's own tour-operator list (SCC EVENTS).
Listed as "Cerita Lari" under Indonesia on the Bank of America Chicago Marathon's own 2026 international partners page.
certifications.source_label: Bank of America Chicago Marathon -- International partners (2026)

certifications.evidence: Cerita Lari's own official event page states "we have been elected to become official International Tour Operator for TCS New York City Marathon 2026", though we could not independently confirm it on NYRR's own tour-operator page (it sits behind a Cloudflare waiting-room queue we couldn't get past).
certifications.source_label: Cerita Lari -- TCS New York City Marathon 2026

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Cerita Lari" under Indonesia in the Tokyo Marathon Foundation's own list of Tokyo Marathon 2027 travel agencies for Asia.
certifications.source_label: Tokyo Marathon Foundation -- Tokyo Marathon 2027 travel agencies (Asia)

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Cerita Lari" under Indonesia on the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon's own International Travel Program page.
certifications.source_label: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon -- International Travel Program

editorial_notes: London Marathon certification verified directly against London Marathon Events' own official tour-operator listing on 2026-08-11. Berlin, Chicago, and New York City certifications are sourced from Cerita Lari's own event-specific pages, which make specific dated/repeated-appointment claims rather than generic marketing copy -- but these are the agency's own claims, not confirmed against the three races' own official operator pages (each uses a dynamic map, a gated PDF, or a queue system we could not get past). Tokyo Marathon was left out in August because Cerita Lari's own page described selling packages through Kintetsu International; the Tokyo Marathon Foundation's own Tokyo Marathon 2027 Asia list now names Cerita Lari directly, so it is included (checked 2026-10-06, after Cerita Lari sent the list). Berlin and Chicago listings (where present) checked against those races' own official tour-operator lists on 2026-10-16.
